PublicWebIndependentReadback.reason: PublicWeb tool cannot fetch the newly created public GitHub URL yet. Public GitHub Projection existence does not equal independent PublicWeb readback.
repair_actions: Retry PublicWeb open after public cache/index propagation
Publish the same Projection to a confirmed website deployment endpoint if available
Keep GitHub public Projection as source evidence without claiming PublicWeb readback

AppleNativeNumbersPagesKeynote.reason: No Apple iWork native IWA writer/readback endpoint is available in this runtime, and no ToolSpecifications .numbers/.pages/.key native file was found.
repair_actions: Attach a macOS/iOS executor with Numbers/Pages/Keynote native write capability
Open the existing MarkdownSeed/XLSX/DOCX/PPTX Projection in the native iWork app and create the native document
Read the package/IWA back and verify Identity, Manifest and ReverseChain before setting exists=true
